name: ibis Styles Stockholm Odenplan
desc: Important Notice - Hotel Renovation - Our hotel will be closed from 14 December 2026 to 14 April 2027 for a full renovation. We are excited to return with an upgraded, refreshed hotel offering even greater comfort and style. Located in the heart of authentic Stockholm, our hotel combines design, comfort, and affordability in a central location. We look forward to welcoming you back on 14 April 2027!

name: Mercure Gothenburg
desc: Mercure Hotel Gothenburg sits by the sea in the historic Nya Varvet shipyard district, 15 minutes from central Gothenburg. Set in buildings dating back to the 1800s, it blends maritime heritage with modern Scandinavian design. The 97 rooms range from Standard to Suite, many with harbour views. Relax at the bar and enjoy food and drinks outdoors in the sun, with sweeping views over the water. A 24-hour deli and lobby…
